description: BMAD v6 Subagent Registry for Antigravity - Declarative Agent-as-Code definitions

subagents.name: bmad-pm
subagents.description: Product Manager responsible for Product Briefs, PRDs, scope definition, and business vision.

subagents.name: bmad-analyst
subagents.description: Business Analyst responsible for deep requirements research, user story breakdown, and PRD refinement.

subagents.name: bmad-architect
subagents.description: System Architect responsible for LLD, tech stack selection, ADRs, database models, and API contracts.

subagents.name: bmad-ux
subagents.description: UX Designer responsible for wireframes, component design, interaction flows, and Figma Dev Mode token extraction.

subagents.name: bmad-sm
subagents.description: Scrum Master responsible for sprint planning, story estimation, and local task.md tracking.

subagents.name: bmad-dev
subagents.description: Developer responsible for TDD implementation, code refactoring, and branch-isolated development.

subagents.name: bmad-tester
subagents.description: Test Architect (TEA Module) responsible for test suites, automated verification, regression testing, and quality gates.

subagents.name: bmad-writer
subagents.description: Tech Writer responsible for documentation maintenance, AST schema audits, API contracts, and user guides.

subagents.name: bmad-party
subagents.description: Multi-Agent Deliberation Council (Architect + Dev + Tester + Security Red Team) for cross-functional debate, risk trade-offs, and pre-flight validation.

subagents.name: bmad-reviewer
subagents.description: Senior Staff Code Reviewer & Security Auditor responsible for PR diff audits, security scanning ([SEC]), SOLID pattern validation, and pre-merge quality gates.
